title: dolichos pearsonii
intro: Dolichos pearsonii, commonly known as the wild bean or forest bean, is a plant species belonging to the Leguminosae family. It is a climber or a shrub, native to tropical Africa, and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Dolichos pearsonii include its potential to lower blood pressure, treat fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
